findings.summary: Telegram docs (2026-09-06) state that in some conditions only official mobile apps receive SMS/call login codes; third-party apps must use in-app Telegram codes, Fragment, email, future-auth tokens, QR, or passkeys. Kizuki implements only phone/code/2FA via GramJS and cannot promise SMS.
findings.limitation: Live sign-in is not qualified and is not guaranteed for every account.
